_comment: Diagnostic fine-tune of v_tau050: isolate the effect of a stronger anti-collapse weight on the specular mask (observed mean coverage 3.1% vs its own 15% target under the original 0.02 weight). Resumes from the existing checkpoint rather than training from scratch, on a small C3VD subset, so this is a fast, targeted test of one specific hypothesis -- not a full retrain.
_mask_ratio_weight_comment: 5x the original hardcoded 0.02, to see whether that was actually the limiting factor behind the 3.1%-vs-15% gap.
_no_cuda_comment: All 4 GPUs on this box are full from other users' jobs (~900MB free, not enough for a CUDA context). Forcing CPU; split shrunk to 160 train / 60 val images and num_epochs to 2 to keep this tolerable.
